# ImageButton

- Inherits [`ImageLabel`](imagelabel.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ImageButton")`

An `ImageLabel` meant to be pressed. It adds no properties of its own: `Activated`, `PointerEntered` and `PointerExited` come from `UIObject`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
